officialFacts: The public archive documents 12 kline fields sourced from /api/v3/klines.
Spot archive timestamps from 2025-01-01 onward are documented as microseconds.
Each archive has an adjacent SHA-256 checksum sidecar.
The Spot API documents kline open time as logical identity and UTC as the default time zone.
projectPredicatesNotBinanceGuarantees: UTC-midnight 1d opens are required by this boundary.
A complete published interval has closeNative equal to openNative plus dayNative minus one.
Only a final truncated interval may be quarantined.
Only contiguous byte-identical same-open records may collapse.
unknowns: Binance does not document physical archive duplicate behavior or deduplication precedence.
Binance does not document the cause of a truncated terminal interval.
The archive documents that published files can later be replaced after errors.
Archive validation cannot establish symbol lifecycle, expected inventory, missing-file legitimacy, or consumer-required coverage.

timestampContract.openRule: exact UTC midnight inside the pinned partition
timestampContract.precisionNote: A millisecond close normalized to microseconds ends in 999000; it is not replaced with a synthetic microsecond 999999 close.

economicInvariants: OHLC values are positive and obey OHLC geometry.
Volumes and trade count are nonnegative.
Taker base and quote volumes do not exceed their corresponding totals.
The ignore field is a nonnegative decimal but is not required to equal zero.

pinned: market, data type, cadence, interval, symbol, and partition
archive basename and expected member basename
archive, checksum-file, and member SHA-256 digests
official source-document commits and content digests
custodyContract.localContextVerification: The executing checkout recomputes policy.v1.json, boundary.py, and quant/uv.lock SHA-256 digests and rejects declared drift.
custodyContract.officialDocumentPinVerification: The declared commits and content digests must equal frozen validator constants; validation performs no live documentation fetch.
custodyContract.checksumMeaning: transfer and current-publisher-byte evidence, not an independent signature or immutability guarantee

duplicateContract.allowed: same-open records contiguous in physical order and byte-identical excluding only LF record terminators
receipt: raw and logical sequence SHA-256 digests
inadmissible: duplicate group or run cap exceeded

truncatedIntervalContract.classification: TERMINAL_TRUNCATED when openNative<=closeNative<expectedCloseNative and the record is the final logical open-time group
inadmissible: truncation before a later logical open

outcomes.ADMISSIBLE: All hard invariants pass, no row is collapsed or quarantined, and complete output is nonempty.
outcomes.ADMISSIBLE_WITH_EXCLUSIONS: All hard invariants pass, only frozen exclusions within caps occur, complete output is nonempty, and the censoring sidecar is mandatory.
outcomes.INADMISSIBLE: Any other defect; emit a failure receipt and no admitted-row artifact.

coverageReceipt.logicalOpenMissingRanges: Partition dates for which no logical open-time group was physically observed.
coverageReceipt.noAdmittedCompleteRowRanges: Partition dates for which no complete bar was emitted, including quarantined logical rows.
coverageReceipt.authority: Neither range establishes lifecycle, legitimate absence, expected inventory, or consumer-required coverage.

twoStageFreeze: Before future input inspection, freeze validator, runtime, policy, expected inventory, allowed exclusions and caps, and lifecycle/censoring behavior.
After offline custody validation and before evaluator or holdout access, freeze acquisition receipts, canonical-output digests, censoring receipts, and a dataset inventory manifest.
forbidden: Treating a collapsed duplicate as extra coverage.
Treating an observed missing day as proof of delisting or harmless absence.
Reintroducing quarantined OHLC into features or marks.
Applying DQ-1 retroactively to repair, reclassify, or rerun a consumed packet.
Opening a sealed holdout without separate protocol authority.
